subject: maths
promptStrong: Give me a 6-mark exam-style question on {lo} for {board} {level} {subject}, then mark my answer against the mark scheme.
promptWeak: Explain {lo} for {board} {level} {subject} simply, with a worked example and the most common mistake students make.

questions.q: For grouped data with classes 0-10, 10-20, 20-30 having frequencies 4, 9, 2, which is the modal class?
questions.explain: The class with the highest frequency (9) is 10-20.
The mode is the most frequent value, which is 7.

questions.q: A survey only asks people leaving a gym about exercise habits. This sample is:
questions.explain: Only gym-goers are sampled, so the sample is biased toward active people.

questions.q: Which value could NOT be a probability?
questions.explain: Probabilities lie between 0 and 1, so 1.2 is impossible.

questions.q: As temperature rises, sales of hot soup fall. This shows:
questions.explain: One increasing while the other decreases is negative correlation.
